|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Yané (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-yane022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/yane.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/yane.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Yané”. Text: “Whenever opponent deploys a character to same or adjacent site, may activate 1 Force. While with Amidala, forfeit +1, and once per turn may peek at the top card of your Force Pile and Reserve Deck; return one card to each deck or pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yané (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-yaneca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/yane.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/yane.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Yané” → “Yané” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); “Amidala, forfeit +1, and once per” → “Amidala, forfeit +1 and, once per”; “once per turn may peek” → “once per turn, may peek”. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Yané”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Whenever opponent deploys a character to same or adjacent site, may activate 1 Force.
